name: slidev
notes: The composable-vue demo deck (demo/composable-vue) built for a sub-directory deploy (slidev build --base /sub/ --out dist/sub) and served as plain files from dist by Behique's own static server, so /sub/ opens the deck's index page and the crawl starts there (the profile's ready path). The deck is built by the workspace's own CLI (@slidev/cli and its packages are built first), so each bisect commit is tested with its own client code. This deck was chosen over demo/starter because the starter's cover uses a remote background image (cover.sli.dev) and white text on it: with no internet in the sandbox the first slide is white on white. The composable-vue cover renders offline, and the deck's navigation bar has a 'Go to next slide' button. Made for the blind bisect of issue #2635 (docs/blind-bisect-runs.md): under a base path, going to the next slide lands on the deck's own 404 page.
